* **Suite check authenticates its GitHub request**: the suite
  consistency check now sends the workflow token, so the shared
  anonymous rate limit no longer fails it.
* **CI actions on their latest releases**: codeql-action 4.39.5,
  markdownlint-cli2-action 25.1.0, cosign-installer 4.1.4 and
  sbom-action 0.24.4, each pinned by commit SHA.
* **In lockstep with the suite's 0.0.37 release**: all fifteen
  repositories ship 0.0.37 together; built against core 0.0.36.
